title: Mind For Music
text: An analysis of how musical genres have evolved across the Billboard Hot 100, comparing all-time chart toppers against every year from 1958 to 2024. You can inspect the complete song-level data on the Explore the data page.

title: Mind For Music
section: Technology & Social Media vs. Music Genre Popularity (1958 – 2024)
text:
Technology & Social Media vs. Music Genre Popularity (1958 – 2024)
How has the rise of personal computing, the internet, social media, and streaming aligned with shifts in musical taste? The two charts below share the same timeline: the top panel tracks the rise of key technologies and platforms, while the bottom panel shows the market share of major music genres on the Billboard Hot 100.

Every Single Hit Song (1958 – 2024)
An interactive chart displaying all 6,700 songs to reach the annual Billboard Top 100. Hover over any point to explore the song title, artist, rank, weeks on chart, and genre.

title: Data Exploration
text:
How has the distribution of musical genres shifted across each decade since the Billboard Hot 100 began? The heatmap below shows the concentration of year-end top hits. Darker blue indicates more hits in that decade. Hover over any tile to see the top song and average staying power, or click to pin the details below.

section: Chart Staying Power: Weeks on Chart by Genre

Chart Staying Power: Weeks on Chart by Genre
Which genres produce songs that linger on the charts the longest? The box plot below illustrates the spread, median, and outliers for weeks charted across each genre. Hover over a box to inspect summary stats, or click to pin information below.

text:
NoteProject Plan



I am planning to compare the top genres in songs from the Billboard Top 100 from the beginning and median years of each decade since the Billboard Top 100 has started. I am also going to find different impactful events from these years or surrounding years and see the impact on the popular genres during that time.
